name: Typhoon
description: SCB 10X's Thai lab runs a free, rate-limited research API for its open models.
overview: Typhoon is SCB 10X's Thai-language research lab, and its OpenAI-compatible API is a research showcase rather than a paid product: every Typhoon text model is served at $0 with no card, at about 5 requests per second and 200 requests per minute for the text models. The current text flagship, Typhoon 2.5 30B A3B Instruct, carries a 131K context and handles Thai, English and code-mixed prompts, with tool calling and streaming available. In exchange the lab collects usage data to improve the models, so it is a research tier in the strict sense — great for Thai work, not somewhere to send confidential text.
free_access: Free research API for every Typhoon text model
Thai, English and code-mixed prompts at 131K context
No card, key from the playground account
notes: Usage data is collected to improve the models and there is no SLA. The OCR and speech models share the same key but are not LLMs.
